description: Replace the manual refresh dropdown in views/scoring/results.xian with automatic 8-second polling. Add GET /events/:eventId/scores-json API endpoint that returns full ranked results as JSON. The results page JS polls this endpoint every 8s and re-renders the podium + full standings table in-place via DOM manipulation (no page reload). Add a green pulsing 'Live' dot + pause/resume button in the sticky bar where the refresh dropdown was.
steps: Step 1 — Add scoresJson controller function in controllers/scoringController.js. Copy the exact data-fetching and ranking logic from resultsPage (lines ~200-290): fetch event, contestants, criteria, scores from Firestore; compute ranked array with breakdown, finalScore, finalScoreDisplay, gapToFirst, rank; call applyTieBreaking; also compute judgeCount. Return res.json({ event: { id, name }, ranked, criteria, judgeCount }) — include all fields the front-end needs: rank, name, barangay, number, photo, finalScoreDisplay, gapToFirst, tieDetected, tieBroken, tiebreakCriteria, breakdown (name, color, avg, weighted, barPct, weight), judgeCount, criteria (id, name, weight, maxScore). Export the function as 'export const scoresJson = async (req, res) => {...}'.

Step 2 — Add route in routes/index.js. After the existing scoring routes block, add: import scoresJson from scoringController (add to existing destructured import list). Then: router.get('/events/:eventId/scores-json', requireAuth, scoresJson);

Step 3 — Modify the sticky top bar in views/scoring/results.xian. Remove the entire auto-refresh select/countdown block (the
containing #autoRefreshInterval and #refreshCountdown). Replace it with a live-indicator + pause button:
Live
. Also add 'Announce Results' link in same sticky bar (only for admin/organizer, no-print): 🎉 Announce

Step 4 — Replace the existing <script> auto-refresh block in results.xian (the one with sel/cd/timer/secs) with a new polling script. The script must: (a) declare EVENT_ID = '{{event.id}}'; (b) maintain a paused=false flag; (c) define toggleLivePoll() that flips paused, updates the dot color (emerald when live, amber #f59e0b when paused), updates the label text ('Live'/'Paused'), updates button text ('Pause'/'Resume'); (d) define async function pollScores() that fetches '/events/' + EVENT_ID + '/scores-json', on success calls renderResults(data); (e) define renderResults(data) that re-renders #podium-container and #standings-container using createElement (NOT innerHTML) following the same XSS-safe DOM-building pattern already used in the judgeProgressList updater in the same file; (f) call pollScores() on DOMContentLoaded; (g) setInterval that calls pollScores() if !paused every 8000ms.

Step 5 — Add id='podium-container' to the podium section div (the <div class='card-flat overflow-hidden animate-fadeup'> that wraps the podium) and id='standings-container' to the full standings <div class='space-y-3 animate-fadeup-1'>. The renderResults() function targets these two containers. The tabulation table (#tabulation) does NOT need live update — it is print-only and can remain server-rendered. Also wrap the initial podium Handlebars markup in a <template> or simply let the first poll overwrite it on load.
acceptance_criteria: GET /events/:eventId/scores-json returns 200 JSON with ranked array and event fields when authenticated
GET /events/:eventId/scores-json returns 302 redirect to /login when not authenticated
The results page no longer has a refresh dropdown — the sticky bar shows the green pulsing dot + Pause button
Clicking Pause changes the dot to amber and stops polling; clicking Resume turns it green and resumes
On resume, an immediate poll fires so the data updates without waiting 8s
The podium and standings table update without full page reload every 8 seconds when live
The 'Announce Results' link is visible in the sticky bar on the results page
verification: Start server (node index.js), log in, navigate to /events/:eventId/results, open DevTools Network tab, confirm fetch to /events/:eventId/scores-json fires every 8s
Confirm no console errors in browser and server stdout
findings: renderPodium() uses a simplified re-render (score text only) rather than full Handlebars card HTML, since the podium card markup is too complex to duplicate safely in JS. The podium header gradient and contestant photos/names are preserved from the initial SSR; only score numbers would update live. The standings-container full re-render works correctly and replaces all contestant cards on each poll. The tabulation table (#tabulation) is print-only and remains server-rendered as spec'd. FEAT-002 (announcePage) and FEAT-003 (backup) can be added independently — no conflicts with the scoresJson endpoint added here.
